styles.name: Charcoal waist apron with eyelets for the self fabric waist ties — Tibard, Gaucho
styles.desc: WAIST APRON · Self fabric waist ties set through two 30 mm antique brass eyelets at the top of the waist and secured with two rows of stitching · Waist ties edgestitched both sides · No pocket · Tibard printed care label, no logo
styles.lectra: OHAP0777, variant OHAP0777 — cut even number bundles and no piece outs: the right and wrong sides of the fabric are very similar
fabrics: Charcoal Panama 260 gsm PC260-520-L--160, 65% recycled polyester / 35% organic cotton (Carringtons) — rating 0.40 m
trims: THREAD — COATS EPIC 80'S STORM GREY 09963 — cost per metre
THREAD — COATS EPIC 80'S MAROON 03912 — listed on the works order for contrast ties; the ties are self fabric, so most likely left over from the template

Printed care label (at Tibard): 65% recycled polyester / 35% organic cotton · 60° wash reduced cycle · no bleach · 2 dot iron · tumble dry low · do not dry clean. Set 14 cm down from the finished right side seam as worn.

Listed on the works order: set to the strap, 2 male and 2 female at each end, use the marker, 4 studs in all. A waist apron has no strap and the sketch shows no studs, so most likely left over from the bib apron template (AP0776128): check with the GT before setting.
The female part of the studs listed above, 2 per apron if they are set.
30 mm eyelet and ring, antique brass (30 mm E/R AB), 2 per apron. Set to the top of the waist: centre of the eyelet 2.5 cm down from the top edge and 2.5 cm in from each side of the apron.
The ring for the 30 mm eyelet, 2 per apron.
mfg: Sides and hem: double turned and topstitched to finish 12 mm from the edge. Insert the label to the right side seam as worn, 14 cm down from the finished top edge.
Top hem: double turn 1 cm + 5 cm and stitch down.
Make the waist ties: bag out both ends and edgestitch both long edges.
After the eyelets are set (finishing), set each waist tie through its eyelet and secure with two rows of stitching.
fin: Set the eyelets to the top of the waist, one each side: centre of the eyelet 2.5 cm in from the side seam and 2.5 cm down from the top edge. The apron then goes back to the machinist for the waist ties to be set through the eyelets.
Fold and set into a bag. Product sticker set to the bottom right hand corner.
styles.note: Works order AP0777128 for Gaucho, Tibard (JH created 5/9/23; created for bulk and amended to a Tibard product JH 2/10/23; YL 13/8/24 added the cutting note: cut even number bundles and no piece outs, the fabric's right and wrong sides are very similar). The waist apron version of the AP0776128 bib apron: the ties are set through the eyelets after finishing, so the apron goes back to the machinist once the eyelets are in. Rating 0.40 m on the sheet and in All Costings; no lay plan marker for OHAP0777, so the PM can set the lay. The maroon contrast thread and the bronze studs are listed on the sheet with no rating, left from the bib apron template: the ties are self fabric and a waist apron has no strap. The sheet's sketch of the apron is in works-orders/AP0777128-Gaucho.xlsx.
